schema: PHY-13 COR compatibility rule table, draft 0.1 (TECHNICAL_SPEC §3.2). AF-30: rules as data with sources.

rules.name: MIL-STD-889D galvanic corrosion rate matrix
rules.method: Anodic-member corrosion rate (mil/year) of a 1:1 area couple under artificial seawater, from joint polarization curves (mixed potential). Rows = anodic member, columns = cathodic member; an empty cell means the members are swapped.

compatibleBelow.source: S2 (NAWCAD slides, category 0 < 0.009 mil/yr) + S1 summary

rules.scopeLimit: The table shall not be used to indicate the level of risk of a couple nor the level of protection required (S2, S3). llull reports the cell; it never derives a protection level from it.
rules.matrix: tbd: transcribe from MIL-STD-889D (DoD ASSIST, public) into galvanic_889d_matrix.json; no cell is shipped until read from the standard

rules.name: Anodic index difference (non-889 screening)
rules.method: |AI(anode) - AI(cathode)| <= limit(environment); the member with the larger index is the anode
rules.label: industrial rule of thumb, NOT MIL-STD-889; S8 says not for critical applications such as aerospace flying parts

rules.name: Small anode / large cathode
rules.method: report Aa/Ac (wetted anode area / cathode area); warn when the anode is the smaller member (Aa/Ac < 1)
rules.basis: corrosion concentrates on a small anode coupled to a large cathode (S9); 889D values assume a 1:1 ratio (S2, S3)
rules.threshold: directional only (no numeric limit found); a company limit can be supplied and is then named

rules.name: Carbon fibre composite in contact with aluminium
rules.method: CFRP (carbon) is noble to aluminium; direct contact is flagged unless an isolation is declared (glass ply, sealant, primer/adhesive layer)
rules.source: S10 (Composite Envisions note; forum practice of a glass barrier ply, wet installation)

rules.name: Stress-corrosion cracking susceptibility (sodium chloride environments)
rules.method: classify alloy + temper (+ product form, grain direction) into MSFC-STD-3029A Table I (high resistance), II (moderate), III (low); Table II/III require an approved materials usage agreement
rules.tables: scc_classes.json (entries tbd except the listed secondary facts)

rules.name: Hydrogen embrittlement flag
rules.method: steel with Ftu >= threshold and an electroplated or acid-processed surface system => warn (bake / plating process control required)

threshold.source: S13 (NAS672 scope: cadmium plating of steel heat-treated to 180 ksi and higher)

rules.note: S14 reports a historical restriction of cadmium electroplating on steels above 220 ksi; S15 ASTM F519 baseline 4340 at 260-280 ksi

rules.name: Remedy vocabulary (not requirements)

remedies.spec: MIL-PRF-81733 Type II (extrusion) / wet installation of fasteners

rules.note: llull proposes remedies as options with sources; selecting one is a design decision (reviewRequired)
